capability-state-machine.notes: fs-persisted sealed/open/burned machine with unary revision guard, typed illegal-transition and stale-refusal outcomes, and deterministic recovery from missing/corrupt documents

string-escapes.notes: source string escapes (\ \n \r \t \0 \") decode to their characters; previously \n silently stayed as two literal characters

source-modules-use.semantics: explicit `module <name>` declaration per imported file (basename must match); `use <module>.<item>` per line; qualified references (module.item); DFS discovery from the entry's use graph in source order; entry file is the program root and declares no module
